question.problem:
$$
{{[\begin{aligned}5 & 10 & -4 \\ -5 & 10 & -2 \\ 20 & 40 & -15\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}={{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ \boxed{} & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{L}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}5 & 10 & -4 \\ 0 & 20 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{U}
$$

Consider the LU factorization of the matrix $A$ above. What is the value of the entry ${l}_{31}$ in the matrix $L?$
question.worked_solution:
We want to make $0$ at the position ${a}_{31}$ using Gaussian elimination. To do this, we take the $3$rd row of $A,$ and we add the $1$st row of $A$ multiplied by $-4:$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}5 & 10 & -4 \\ -5 & 10 & -2 \\ 20 & 40 & -15\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-4){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}5 & 10 & -4 \\ -5 & 10 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The entry ${l}_{31}$ of the matrix $L$ is the factor next to ${R}_{1},$ taken with the opposite sign:

$$
{l}_{31}=-(-4)=4.
$$
